questions.solution:

Answer: choice of hardware configuration for an application

questions.text: Which one of the following is a functional requirement ?
questions.solution:
Maintainability, portability and robustness describe how well the system works (non-functional), not what it does. None is a functional requirement.

Answer: None of the mentioned

questions.text: If in a software project the number of user input, user output, enquiries, files and external interfaces are (15, 50, 24, 12, 8), respectively, with complexity average weighing factor. The productivity if effort = 70 percent-month is
questions.solution:
With average weights (4, 5, 4, 10, 7):
UFP = 15 [latex]\times[/latex] 4 + 50 [latex]\times[/latex] 5 + 24 [latex]\times[/latex] 4 + 12 [latex]\times[/latex] 10 + 8 [latex]\times[/latex] 7 = 60 + 250 + 96 + 120 + 56 = 582

Productivity = FP / effort = 582 / 70 [latex]\approx[/latex] 8.3 FP per person-month. This does not match any option; the official key marks 408.74.

Answer: 408.74 (as per key)
